instrumentation: Ephemeral init observers wrap Storage mutations and IndexedDB object-store writes without changing arguments/results. A context binding retains bounded mutation/lifecycle metadata across reload. A separate task-owned preview serves the verified emitted inventory with fixture credentials and public,max-age=0,must-revalidate headers. No Playwright routing is installed; a minimal away page is served by this test-only server. Diagnostic-only exception: the three response bodies listed in observerPreparation are replaced by synchronous observation projections of their exact emitted originals. Native calls, results, thrown values and original readiness/test deadlines are unchanged. This is not an uninstrumented qualification pass.
limitations: Diagnostic only; never replaces unchanged restoration qualification.
Only three declared JavaScript response bodies are instrumented. Original function arguments/results/throws retained; no yields, skipped work, error filters or gate/deadline changes.
All original control/watch/practice reload assertions and cleanup remain unchanged. Observations cannot prove unrelated CPU cost or eliminate timing perturbation.

The preview serves the verified emitted inventory, with only the declared local HTML access-credential exception. This run does not establish offline HTML integrity; service workers are observed, never blocked or unregistered.
Reload is not browser discard; no actual discard is claimed.
BFCache is proved only by pageshow.persisted=true and the original document identity; failed admission is reported separately.

Solo explicitly suspends Demo on pagehide, including persisted history navigation, in inherited upstream app.mjs behavior. A paused watching return documents that policy; it does not prove preservation of playing intent through freeze/resume.
Fresh ephemeral test profiles exercise ordinary entry and compare a control reload. This does not replay every possible saved-game recovery state.
Read/write observers detect API calls, not every browser-internal storage mechanism. Existing persistence and saved-flight tests remain complementary.

Background managed-media asset-cache writes (game/managed-media-store.mjs) are recorded separately from player progress, saves, recovery and tuning; the ordinary app can preload those assets independently of Demo.
